# alexa-mcp (MCP Central)

> **Alexa MCP** — FastMCP acoustic bridge: neural TTS (edge-tts, miniaudio, sounddevice) to a physical Echo, local STT (faster-whisper) from the mic, **interact** / **speak_command** / **listen** tools, **web_sota** dashboard (ports 10800/10801), persisted playback settings, **TTS shopping guard** for Amazon-shaped purchase lines (env `ALEXA_SHOPPING_GUARD`). Version **0.3.x**. Full changelog and README in the main repo `D:\Dev\repos\alexa-mcp`.

## Docs in this folder

- [README.md](README.md) — fleet summary, links to canonical repo and CHANGELOG.
- [STATUS.md](STATUS.md) — status and ports.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — short mirror; authoritative file is in the main repo.

## Configuration pointers

- [metadata_sync.json](metadata_sync.json) — id, path, GitHub URL.
